Earlier vaccination models can genuinely exhibit backward bifurcation, so their results do not dominate this source-specific sign proof.

value.rationale: The result removes an entire purported subthreshold one/two-endemic-equilibrium regime from the model's phase diagram. It rules out the backward/saddle-node branch described in Theorem 3.3 and reduces equilibrium existence to the exact vaccinated reproduction threshold, while leaving genuinely different backward-bifurcation vaccination models untouched.
